newsitem.title: USA: Jacor Communications Inc debt rating cut.
newsitem.headline: Jacor Communications Inc debt rating cut.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it lowered its ratings on Jacor Communications Inc's 15-year liquid yield option notes (LYONs) to single-B from double B-minus and unit Jacor Communications Co's senior subordinated notes to single-B-plus from double-B.
Duff & Phelps said $400 million of debt is affected.
The move follows the rapid expansion of the company through the acquisition of Citicasters Inc in September of 1996, which increased Jacor's leverage, Duff & Phelps said.
Jacor is one of the nation's largest radio station groups.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Tuesday at 26-3/4.
